tasks.title: Reconcile canonical Git history and create foundation branch
tasks.acceptance: Branch starts at origin/main without force-push; local main remains untouched.

tasks.title: Repair source contradictions and record ADR-001 through ADR-008
tasks.acceptance: Blocker and major decisions are consistent across canonical documents and ADRs.

tasks.title: Add executable requirements and task traceability
tasks.acceptance: Every MVP FR has an owner, phase, task, contract, test placeholder, and release gate.

tasks.title: Scaffold Go, Python 3.12, React Vite, contracts, and local development
tasks.acceptance: All language scaffolds compile and their smoke tests pass without product behavior.

tasks.title: Add documentation, task, contract, license, and traceability validation
tasks.acceptance: Invalid local links, task IDs, contract invariants, licenses, and traceability entries fail verification.

tasks.title: Add CI, dependency scanning, secret scanning, and changed-line coverage policy
tasks.acceptance: A clean pull request runs make verify, gitleaks, and dependency review.

tasks.title: Implement FR-103a event-only vehicle activity
tasks.acceptance: Confirmed camera-local vehicle tracks produce deterministic, bounded vehicle_activity events with detected behavior, a canonical shared-detector class, model provenance, and pending human-review state; AI and platform validation exclude LPR, ReID, speed, identity, risk scoring, and theft claims.

tasks.title: Implement abandoned-object temporal logic and evaluation
tasks.acceptance: Camera-local track-separation and configurable 30--60 second dwell rules emit deterministic, review-required abandoned-object alerts; synthetic temporal evaluation passes and production promotion remains gated on held-out per-zone evaluation.

tasks.title: Approve public source publication policy
tasks.acceptance: Owner authorized temporary public implementation publication without an open-source license on 2026-08-12. Default copyright applies and no LICENSE file is added. Legal review and the final public/private policy remain outstanding before GA.

tasks.title: Implement provider-neutral OIDC token verification boundary
tasks.acceptance: Signed tokens require exact issuer, audience, expiry, subject, tenant, role, and canonical authorization claims; invalid tokens fail closed.

tasks.title: Implement five seed roles and deny-by-default authorization
tasks.acceptance: Role grant, explicit scope, MFA, tenant, and site checks are server-enforced with negative tests.

tasks.title: Expose tenant-safe current-user and site read APIs
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated users can read their own context and visible sites; cross-tenant and cross-site rows are never returned.

tasks.title: Add tenant and site Postgres migrations with row-level security
tasks.acceptance: Tenant, site, idempotency, and audit tables migrate idempotently; the non-superuser application role fails closed without a verified transaction-local tenant and cannot read another tenant.

tasks.title: Implement idempotent audited site creation
tasks.acceptance: POST /v1/sites requires tenant-manager authorization, UUIDv4 correlation, and a tenant-scoped idempotency key; product state, replay response, and append-only hash-chained audit event commit atomically.

tasks.title: Add tenant event and transactional outbox persistence
tasks.acceptance: Event and outbox tables migrate idempotently, enforce transaction-local tenant RLS, and fail closed for the non-superuser application role.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated idempotent event ingestion
tasks.acceptance: POST /v1/events validates the canonical event contract and site scope; one event, outbox message, and audit record commit atomically, while duplicate delivery produces one logical event.

tasks.title: Implement leased local outbox dispatch
tasks.acceptance: A tenant-scoped worker leases unpublished messages with SKIP LOCKED, records attempts, releases failed leases, and marks only successfully published messages complete.

tasks.title: Project events idempotently into the alert queue
tasks.acceptance: Each accepted event produces at most one tenant- and site-scoped alert and consumer receipt; GET /v1/alerts returns only authorized queue rows in priority order.

tasks.title: Connect Alert Center to audited REST and resumable realtime alerts
tasks.acceptance: The React Alert Center validates v1 alert envelopes, lists the tenant queue, acknowledges with idempotency and correlation headers, consumes site-ticketed WebSocket snapshots and events, resumes from the last sequence after reconnect, resyncs on gaps, and retains an explicit credential-free demo mode.

tasks.title: Build an alert-derived operations dashboard foundation
tasks.acceptance: The responsive operations dashboard derives queue KPIs, module and severity distributions, and incident drill-downs from the tenant-scoped alert feed; labels every synthetic or unavailable analytics and camera-health value; and exposes chart data in accessible tables.

tasks.title: Build a privacy-safe Camera Wall foundation
tasks.acceptance: The responsive Camera Wall provides searchable and filterable camera metadata, 1/4/9/16/25 layouts, keyboard tile navigation, alert-linked spotlight and queue views, synthetic-only demo scenes, and an explicit unavailable state until tenant-scoped audited streaming APIs exist.

tasks.title: Implement the tenant-scoped camera registry foundation
tasks.acceptance: Camera CRUD enforces tenant and site authorization, transaction-local RLS, per-tenant serial uniqueness, optimistic configuration versions, allowed lifecycle transitions, idempotent creation, soft retirement, and atomic append-only auditing; Camera Wall validates and renders metadata-only live inventory without exposing credentials or footage.

tasks.title: Implement one-time edge-device claim and activation
tasks.acceptance: An authorized administrator issues an idempotent 24-hour device claim whose bearer token is never persisted in plaintext; activation validates the signed tenant and serial, atomically consumes the token once, binds the edge device to its tenant and site under RLS, and appends audit records without secrets.

tasks.title: Implement certificate-authenticated device heartbeat and fleet status
tasks.acceptance: An active registry device submits bounded idempotent telemetry only when its verified client-certificate UUID matches the route; tenant/site-scoped fleet reads derive offline after the canonical 90-second heartbeat age, and RLS plus the guarded heartbeat function prevent cross-tenant table access.

tasks.title: Connect the Go edge agent to certificate-authenticated heartbeat transport
tasks.acceptance: The edge agent sends bounded telemetry over a caller-configured TLS 1.3/mTLS client to the documented heartbeat route, generates correlation and heartbeat UUIDv4 values, preserves replay identity, rejects malformed responses, and schedules attempts no slower than the canonical 30-second interval without tenant or user credentials.

tasks.title: Add supervised FFmpeg RTSP ingest transport
tasks.acceptance: The Go edge agent validates RTSP/RTSPS camera sources, starts a TCP-by-default FFmpeg pull with bounded connection timeouts, reports credential-safe lifecycle state, and restarts unexpected exits with bounded exponential backoff; fake-runner tests cover command construction, cancellation, retries, and secret-safe errors.

tasks.title: Add codec-aware H.264 and H.265 decode selection
tasks.acceptance: The edge RTSP supervisor selects normalized H.264/H.265 FFmpeg decoders, prefers allowlisted Jetson or CUDA hardware paths in auto mode, falls back deterministically to software, fails closed for unavailable forced hardware, and reports only credential-safe codec capability state.

tasks.title: Add durable bounded edge store-and-forward spool
tasks.acceptance: Opaque payloads persist atomically across restart with integrity verification; replay prioritizes metadata, evidence, then archive video and removes items only after acknowledgement; quota pressure evicts the globally oldest item first; queue depth, bytes, oldest age, enqueue, acknowledgement, and eviction metrics are available for telemetry.

tasks.title: Extend edge heartbeat with bounded health telemetry
tasks.acceptance: The edge health monitor reports bounded CPU, GPU, temperature, and inference-latency samples no slower than every 30 seconds, derives thermal warnings at canonical thresholds, and transports optional backward-compatible health through the certificate-authenticated heartbeat into tenant-scoped persisted fleet status.
